promise: Create a €500 billion debt-financed infrastructure fund over the next ten to twelve years, with €100 billion earmarked for the climate transition
description: Germany amended the Basic Law in March 2025 to enable a EUR500 billion infrastructure and climate-neutrality special fund. The government reports that the fund was operating from October 2025, with a twelve-year investment programme and EUR100 billion assigned to the Climate and Transformation Fund.
evidence: German parliament approved the €500bn infrastructure fund and debt-brake changes in March 2025
€100bn allocated to the Climate Transition Fund

review.note: Primary government account says March 2025 constitutional amendment enabled the fund, while implementation was operating from October 2025. Creating a fund is not disbursing all EUR500bn. Exact March 4 wording, climate allocation added in negotiations, and 2037 cutoff require separate original evidence.
